hero.emblem: Lumoxia emblem, an eight-point Sumerian rosette
hero.tagline: Ancient games, rebuilt as apps with new art and thoughtful software.
mission.lead: Lumoxia is an indie studio. The oldest games ever played are still good to play, and good art and software can bring them to new players.
mission.c1.p: Games that are thousands of years old, rebuilt with new art. The rules stay true to the original and the app is easy to pick up.
mission.c2.p: Simple rules, clear visuals and no ads.
mission.c3.p: AI tools are part of how Lumoxia is made, from design to code.
game.shot: {app:title} app showing a game in progress: ivory and carnelian stones on the board, the dice, and an Ivory to move message
game.eyebrow: First app, out now on iOS and Android
game.p: One of the oldest known board games, played in Mesopotamia about 4,500 years ago. This version has new art and simple rules.
game.b1: Eleven board designs, including one based on the original board in the British Museum.
game.b2: Play a friend on one device, or play the computer.
game.b3: Nine languages. Works offline, with no account, no ads and no tracking. One optional, one-time purchase opens every board and stone colour.
music.p1: The game has its own soundtrack. Slow, warm and a little strange, it is written to sit under a long game of dice and stones rather than to compete with it. The tracks are made with AI tools, like the rest of Lumoxia, and shaped by hand until they sound right for the board.
music.p2: The official album, {{album}}, collects the board soundtracks. Listen to it on your favourite service.
music.links.label: Listen to the album
about.p: Giorgio is a computer scientist who has spent his career working on AI. He makes Lumoxia on his own, with AI companions and four cats, out of a long interest in ancient games.

privacy.meta: {app:title} for iOS and Android. Last updated 3 November 2026.
privacy.short: In short: {app:title} does not collect any data about you. It has no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and the game works offline. It has one optional purchase that unlocks every board and stone colour, paid for through the App Store or Google Play.
privacy.stores.h: What the app stores on your device
privacy.stores.p1: The app keeps a few things on your device, so the game remembers them next time:
privacy.stores.l1: your settings: player names, stone colours, board design, language, sound and the shake-to-roll switch;
privacy.stores.l2: your game statistics: the results of games played on this device, shown in the Stats panel.
privacy.stores.l3: your progress: how many games you have finished, which boards and stone colours you have unlocked, and which festive boards you have.
privacy.stores.p2: This information stays on your device and is never sent to Lumoxia. Lumoxia cannot see it, and the app itself sends it nowhere. If you use your phone's backup, your device may copy this information, and only this information, to your own Google Account (Android), so that it comes back when you reinstall the app or move to a new phone. Google makes and keeps that copy under its own privacy policy, and Lumoxia cannot read it. When you set up a new phone, the system may also carry this information across from your old phone. Lumoxia cannot read it then either.
privacy.stores.p3: You can erase the statistics at any time with “{app:statsReset}” in the Stats panel. A backup you already made keeps the older copy until your next backup replaces it, and you can delete backups in your Google account settings. Deleting the app removes the information from the device.
privacy.not.h: What the app does not do
privacy.not.l1: The game itself sends nothing to the internet or to any server of ours.
privacy.not.l2: It does not use analytics, crash reporting, advertising or third-party software that collects data.
privacy.not.l3: It does not track you across other apps or websites and does not ask for tracking permission.
privacy.not.l4: It does not ask for your location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone or any account.
privacy.not.l5: It does not see or store your payment details. Apple or Google handles every payment.
privacy.iap.p1: The app offers one optional, one-time purchase that opens every board and every stone colour. You can also unlock boards and colours for free by playing games. There is no subscription and there are no ads.
privacy.iap.p2: Apple or Google takes the payment and keeps the record of it, under their own privacy policies. Lumoxia receives no payment details and no personal information, and never learns who bought. To show that you own the unlock, the app asks the App Store or Google Play on your device, which may use the internet for that check. Nothing else is sent.
privacy.keep.p: Lumoxia holds no data about you, so there is nothing to keep, delete or hand over, and no consent to withdraw. What the app stores stays on your device, and in your own Google backup if you use one. Deleting the app removes it from the device; a backup you made stays in your account until you delete it there. Lumoxia shares no data with anyone. The record of a purchase is kept by Apple or Google, so ask them about it.
privacy.motion.p: If you switch on “shake to roll” (it is off by default), the app reads your device’s motion sensor while the game screen is showing, only to detect a shake. The readings are used on the spot and then discarded. They are never saved or sent anywhere.
privacy.links.h: Links to other websites and services
privacy.links.p: The app has links to other websites and services. The Rules panel links to Lumoxia on GitHub, a history video on YouTube, the album on Spotify, and ElevenLabs, which is credited for the sound effects. The music strip on the game screen links to each board’s track on Spotify. The Rules panel also links to this Privacy Policy and to the Support page. When you tap one, your device opens it, in your browser or in another app such as Spotify. That website or service then deals with you under its own privacy policy, which Lumoxia does not control.
privacy.children.p: Because the app collects no personal information, it collects none from children either. Apple’s and Google’s parental controls decide whether a child can buy, and Lumoxia has no say in them.
privacy.site.p: If you choose a language, this site remembers your choice in your browser on your own device. It is never sent anywhere. The site sets no cookies.
privacy.changes.p: If the app ever changes what it does with data, this page will be updated and the date above before the change ships.
support.meta: {app:title} for iOS and Android. Last updated 25 October 2026.
support.intro: Need help with {app:title}, or found a problem? Write to the address below and you will get a reply.
support.subject: {app:title} support
support.include.l1: your device (for example iPhone 16, iPad Air or Pixel 9) and its iOS, iPadOS or Android version;
support.include.l2: the app version (shown in Settings → Apps → Royal Game of Ur);
support.include.l3: what you did, what you expected and what happened. A screenshot helps.
support.q1.a: Tap the book icon at the top left of the game for the rules. In short: roll the four dice, move one stone the number shown, land on a rosette for an extra turn, capture an opponent’s stone in the shared middle lane, and be first to bring all seven stones off the board.
support.q2.q: Can I play against the computer, or with a friend?
support.q2.a: Both. On the first screen choose “{app:modeShortHvc}” to play the computer or “{app:modeShortHvh}” to share one device.
support.q3.q: How do I change the language, sound or boards?
support.q3.a: The language button is at the top right. The gear icon opens sound settings, including the shake-to-roll switch. The board button on the first screen lists the eleven board designs.
support.q4.q: How do I reset or delete my statistics?
support.q4.a: Open {app:statsLabel} from the first screen. “{app:statsReset}” clears everything, and you can also delete a single player.
support.q5.q: Does the app need an account or internet connection?
support.q5.a: No account is needed. The game works offline and collects no data. The App Store or Google Play needs a connection only when you buy or restore the unlock. See the Privacy Policy.
support.q6.a: One optional, one-time purchase opens every board and every stone colour. Boards and colours also unlock for free as you finish games, so the game is fully playable without paying.
support.q7.q: How do I restore my purchase?
support.q7.a: Open the purchase screen and tap “Restore purchases”, signed in to the Apple ID or Google account you bought with. This also works after reinstalling the app or on a new device.
support.q8.a: Refunds are handled by Apple for App Store purchases and by Google for Google Play purchases. Lumoxia cannot issue them. If something went wrong with the unlock itself, write to us and we will help. Apple: reportaproblem.apple.com. Google: support.google.com/googleplay.
age.meta: {app:title} for iOS and Android. Last updated 3 November 2026.
age.short: In short: {app:title} is a two-player dice and strategy board game. It has no violence, no chat, no accounts, no ads and no tracking.
age.content.p: So you can judge for yourself, here is what the app does and does not contain:
age.content.l1: No violence. Stones race along a board, and a stone can send an opposing stone back to the start. Nothing is hurt, and there are no fighting scenes.
age.content.l2: No gambling and no simulated gambling. Dice decide how far a stone moves, but nothing is wagered and nothing of real or virtual value can be won or lost.
age.content.l3: No bad language, no sexual or mature content, no references to drugs, alcohol or tobacco, and nothing frightening.
age.content.l4: No user-generated content and no way to message or contact other players. You play a friend on one device, or you play the computer. There is no online multiplayer.
age.content.l5: No accounts, and no sign-in of any kind.
age.content.l6: No access to your location, contacts, photos, camera or microphone.
age.buy.p1: The app offers one optional, one-time purchase that opens every board and stone colour. Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play) takes the payment. The store’s own parental controls, such as Ask to Buy and Screen Time on Apple devices or Family Link on Android, decide whether a child can buy it, and Lumoxia has no say in them.
age.buy.p2: The Rules panel has a few links to other websites (the Lumoxia pages, a history video, the album and each board’s track on Spotify, and the credits for the sound tools). They open outside the app, and Lumoxia does not control those websites or services.
age.privacy.p: The app collects no personal information from anyone, children included. The full policy is on the Privacy Policy page.
age.region.p: {app:title} is not a social media app. It has no accounts, no profiles and no way for people to contact each other, so age-based rules for social media accounts, such as the rule for people under 16 in Australia, do not apply to it. This is a description of the app, not legal advice.
age.changes.p: If the app ever adds something that changes the above, such as online play, chat or ads, this page will be updated, with the date above, before the change ships.
age.contact.p: Write to the address below, or see the Support page.
